title: WebSocketEvent
description: The typed envelope for every future WebSocket message beyond the current connectivity-check heartbeat/echo (architecture.md §23, backend/app/api/websocket/connectivity.py). No event_type below is emitted by the backend yet — this defines the shape future producers/consumers must agree on.

payload.description: Shape depends on event_type — e.g. simulation_frame carries a TimelineFrame, recommendation_created carries a ResponseRecommendation.
